rules.rule: Documentation: check only that commands, paths, links and facts are correct. Never comment on style or wording.
Each test proves one acceptance behaviour through the public interface. Flag a test that asserts configuration, YAML, documentation or repository text, or that duplicates another test.
A migration must be reversible, or say why not. Check for data loss, long locks and missing backfills.
Flag only defects a user or operator would notice, security problems, or broken contracts. Never style or naming. Learned rules go above this one.
